adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new refresh flow throws unless `response.statusText === "OK"` (`if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw ...`). This is a correctness bug because `statusText` is not a reliable success indicator (it can vary by server/runtime and may be empty), so successful responses could be incorrectly treated as failures. The diff also adds nontrivial token-refresh + credential-update logic without any accompanying tests, but the brittle `statusText` check is itself a verifiable defect introduced by the change.
